_comment: Regression baseline for the verifier. Each sample document lists the rules-path verdict every claim must receive, keyed by a distinctive fragment of the claim text rather than by unit_id, so adding a line to a sample does not invalidate the file.

clean_resume.md.note: Assembled only from real profile bullets. Any unsupported verdict here is a false reject, which is the failure mode a fabrication-only metric hides.

fabricated_resume.md.note: One planted defect per failure mode.

planted_defects.Configured Kafka ingestion pipelines: unplaced -- Kafka is a skills-line mention with no role behind it; the Amazon streaming work used SQS
planted_defects.Built a Qdrant vector store: misplaced -- Qdrant evidence points at exp_1 (AIPetique), not exp_2 (Amazon)
planted_defects.Stripe: company and title -- an employer never worked at
planted_defects.Trained and served retrieval models on a: unsupported -- Kubeflow appears nowhere in the profile

known_blind_spot.Led payments infrastructure work: The rules path returns `softened` because the sentence names no tool, company, or metric. The LLM judge returns `unsupported`, correctly: no payments or billing work exists anywhere in the profile. A fabrication told without proper nouns is invisible to element-based checking, which is why both paths are run.
